title: The Right Person, the Right Gown
teaser: Twenty-five minutes before a new surgeon's job interview, Asuka turns the small administrative conference room into a clinical surgical-gown fitting, leads a five-doctor hiring panel for applicant Maki Aizawa, and tests a sky-mist-blue sample gown alongside scrub nurse Hiroko Sugimura.
gallery_caption: Between recruiting a young surgeon and refining every seam of next quarter's sterile gowns, Asuka puts both candidates through real operating-room standards.

choices.choice_al2_b1_a: “Her safety floor is solid—what she lacks is live-case fluency. With a clear three-month mentoring ladder, she's worth training.”
choices.choice_al2_b1_b: “Someone who fears clinical consequences and sketches post-op reviews on her own is steadier to train than an overconfident veteran.”
choices.choice_al2_c1_a: “The back overlap lies flat too—when you raised your arms just now, nothing pulled or bunched across your shoulder blades.”
choices.choice_al2_c1_b: “You had such directorial authority hiring a new surgeon just now—how come trying on a new gown makes you happier than anyone?”

nodes.al2_001: It was 1:35 p.m.—twenty-five minutes before the 2:00 p.m. recruitment interview for a new general surgeon.
nodes.al2_002: When Ryuji Sakaguchi pushed open the door of the small administrative conference room with the morning's panel notice in hand, he had expected to find a roomful of solemn examiners paging through résumés.
nodes.al2_003: Half a step across the threshold, he stopped in his tracks.
nodes.al2_004: Several core figures of Hoshimi's surgical department had indeed gathered inside—only not one of them was seated at the conference table. A thick medical-textile swatch book lay open on the side table by the window, beside a rolling rack hung neatly with four or five crew-neck, long-sleeved surgical gowns in slightly different cuts, necklines, and shades; Asuka Shiromiya stood before the rack clutching a soft measuring tape and a fountain pen, eyes sparkling as she sized something up.
nodes.al2_005: At the sound of the door opening, Asuka turned right around and flashed Ryuji Sakaguchi a bright, lively smile.
nodes.al2_006: “Ah, Dr. Sakaguchi, right on time! Come on in and shut the door behind you!”
nodes.al2_007: Sakaguchi stepped inside, closed the door, and let his gaze travel back and forth between the applicant folders on the long table and the row of surgical gowns.
nodes.al2_008: “...I didn't walk into the wrong room, did I? My notice definitely said a two o'clock interview for a new surgeon, so why does this look like I stumbled into a medical-supply trade show?”
nodes.al2_009: Standing nearby leafing through the fabric specification cards, Narumi Jinguji gave a light laugh and glanced over at Sakaguchi with an amused lift at the corner of her eye.
nodes.al2_010: “When I pushed the door open ten minutes ago, I thought I'd misread my schedule too.”
nodes.al2_011: “The two o'clock interview is going ahead right on schedule, of course! It's just that our supply vendor happened to drop off next quarter's sterile-gown pattern samples at noon—and getting Dr. Mido, Deputy Chief Pendragon, Dr. Jinguji, and Dr. Sakaguchi in the same room at once is normally next to impossible.”
nodes.al2_012: Asuka patted the non-sterile fitting samples hanging with paper tags on the rack, her voice matter-of-fact yet brimming with undisguised excitement:
nodes.al2_013: “Since our lead surgeons and senior staff are all here twenty minutes early, why not use the window before the interview to slip these three revised samples on, move around a little, and vet them for me! The spec sheet for the standard cotton-blend gowns we use now was set back when my mother ran the hospital—the former Chief of Surgery was famously picky about barrier lining and cuff-rib weight, and we've kept that exact spec for years. Now that it's my turn to sign off on the next generation, we ought to upgrade both functionality and silhouette together!”
nodes.al2_014: Standing by the window with her arms folded, Emiko Mido glanced down at her wristwatch, her brows drawing together ever so slightly.
nodes.al2_015: “Let's get one thing straight: this ends by 1:55 sharp. So long as a sterile gown doesn't block my line of sight or bind my wrists, how it looks on me makes zero difference.”
nodes.al2_016: “How could it make zero difference, Dr. Mido! Come on, please—Sample #1 is a crisp slim-sleeve cut tailored specifically for high-intensity lead surgeons, and that misty-teal matte blend looks super sharp. Just slip off your white coat, pull it on, and run through two motions!”
nodes.al2_017: Unable to fend off the young director's clasped hands and beaming eyes, Emiko Mido gave a cool huff, slipped off her white coat in one clean motion to drape it over a chair back, slid her arms into the misty-teal Sample #1, and loosely fastened the side waist tie behind her.
nodes.al2_018: The instant it settled on her shoulders, the narrowed shoulder line really did accentuate Mido's poised, razor-sharp bearing. Asuka's eyes lit up and she had barely written half the character for 'Good' on her clipboard when Mido, expressionless, raised both hands to chest height and executed a standard sequence of deep-cavity needle-holder wrist rotations and rapid hemostat ties in midair.
nodes.al2_019: After scarcely five seconds, Mido stopped and pointed straight at the inside of her right elbow and her wrist.
nodes.al2_020: “No good. Eliminate Sample #1 outright, or send it back to be recut.”
nodes.al2_021: “Eh?! Why?! Standing still, the shoulders and back lie so wonderfully flat!”
nodes.al2_022: “A surgeon at the table isn't standing at attention for a publicity photo. With the shoulders and upper sleeves taken in this tight, the fabric inside the crook of the elbow digs hard into the forearm muscles the moment you raise your forearms to chest level for deep ligation; and look at the wrist—as soon as I reach forward, the rib-knit cuff rides half an inch back up my wrist.”
nodes.al2_023: As she spoke, Mido briskly undid the tie, slipped Sample #1 off, and handed it back without a trace of compromise:
nodes.al2_024: “Stand through a major case of three hours or more like that, and once the cuff creeps back, the sterile glove margin is bound to slip and contaminate. Good looks won't stop bleeding. This gown fails.”
nodes.al2_025: Sakaguchi nodded quietly from the side and glanced toward Asuka—who had clearly favored #1's clean lines. She stared at the cuff for two seconds, her lips giving the tiniest pout of regret for a split instant before her fountain pen moved without hesitation, slashing a firm revision mark across Sample #1's evaluation box.
nodes.al2_026: “...You're right. The moment you rotated your wrist just now, the rib cuff really did pull back. Insufficient elbow ease plus short sleeve length—noted! What about #2, then? Dr. Pendragon, could you try this wider-cut deep-sea blue sample?”
nodes.al2_027: “Understood. If it is to test mobility during team maneuvers, I am happy to assist.”
nodes.al2_028: Artoria neatly unbuttoned her white coat, folded it flat, and put on the noticeably roomier deep-sea blue Sample #2, even asking Narumi beside her to fasten both the upper and lower back ties properly.
nodes.al2_029: Petite in stature yet ramrod-straight in posture, the Deputy Chief of Surgery stepped into the open space at the center of the room, performed two wide forward two-handed retraction reaches, and then simulated an intraoperative position swap between lead surgeon and first assistant—pivoting crisply half a turn backward and to the side to clear the instrument lane.
nodes.al2_030: Coming cleanly to a halt, Artoria closed her eyes briefly, then opened her emerald gaze toward Asuka.
nodes.al2_031: “The range of motion through the shoulders and underarms is ample. Even four or five straight hours at the table would put no strain on the shoulders—that much deserves credit.”
nodes.al2_032: She raised her right hand and indicated the overlapping hem edge behind her right waist:
nodes.al2_033: “However, to accommodate the generous front cut, the overlap between the two back panels was left too shallow. When I pivoted sideways to yield position just now, a distinct gap billowed open below the back waist tie—in a busy operating room, a loose, flaring back hem can easily brush peripheral equipment in the circulating zone, and it falls short of proper OR discipline.”
nodes.al2_034: Asuka Shiromiya (jotting rapidly on her form):
nodes.al2_035: “Widen the back-panel overlap by at least six centimeters, and raise the outer tie placement... Mm-hmm, crystal clear! Then I'll leave Sample #3, the raglan-sleeve revision, to you, Dr. Jinguji!”
nodes.al2_036: Having already slipped out of her white coat and picked up the slate-celadon Sample #3, Narumi Jinguji slid her arms unhurriedly through the sleeves, stepped before the full-length mirror, leaned slightly forward in an elegant posture of peering down into a deep pelvic field while holding a retractor steady, and turned her head back toward Asuka with a teasing half-smile.
nodes.al2_037: “The raglan sleeve certainly frees up the elbow room Dr. Mido found too tight, and the back drape behaves nicely. Only, Madam Director—whoever drafted this neckline probably doesn't spend much time looking down into a deep pelvic field, do they?”
nodes.al2_038: With one fingertip, Narumi lightly tapped the firm crew-neck binding just above her collarbone:
nodes.al2_039: “The front neckline curve sits too high and the piping is stiff. Keep your head angled down like that for more than twenty minutes and the collar will chafe right under your throat the entire time. I know this prim, high-necked line suits your tastes, Director, but wear it through a pelvic adhesiolysis and everyone will walk out of the OR with a red ring around their neck.”
nodes.al2_040: Ryuji Sakaguchi couldn't help letting out a laugh:
nodes.al2_041: “Three people tried them on for five minutes, and all three sample gowns got wiped out.”
nodes.al2_042: “They were not wiped out—this is called gathering priceless frontline clinical parameters!”
nodes.al2_043: Not the least bit deflated, Asuka bent over the vendor revision sheet to transcribe all three pointed critiques word for word, murmuring earnestly to herself as her pen flew:
nodes.al2_044: “#1 has great shoulder lines, so keep that without binding the elbow—add forearm ease and longer rib-knit cuffs; #2 needs a deeper back overlap against brushing; #3 needs the front neckline dropped one centimeter with soft binding... They have to let all of you lift your arms and pivot at the table without a single hitch, while refusing to hang like a shapeless burlap sack!”
nodes.al2_045: Watching her decisively cross out the narrow sleeve cut she had liked while refusing to surrender clean proportions, Sakaguchi realized firsthand for the first time—the young director's enthusiasm for surgical attire was no passing administrative whim, but a craft she genuinely loved studying.
nodes.al2_046: Just then, the wall clock in the conference room clicked softly onto 1:55.
nodes.al2_047: Before the five-minute warning chime could even sound, Asuka—who a second earlier had been comparing collar curves against the swatch book—snapped the sample binder shut with a crisp clap.
nodes.al2_048: “All right, time's up! Dr. Sakaguchi, give me a hand wheeling the rack behind the screen—everyone else, please slip your white coats back on and take your seats so we don't leave today's applicant waiting anxiously outside.”
nodes.al2_049: Within half a minute, both the sample gowns and the measuring tape vanished behind the corner folding screen. Back in her crisp white coat at the center of the long table, Asuka straightened her posture, her girlish excitement over fabric swatches settling seamlessly into the composed, clear-eyed poise of Hoshimi's hospital director.
nodes.al2_050: At 2:00 p.m. on the dot, three measured, restrained knocks sounded outside the conference room door.
nodes.al2_052: The door opened quietly, and a young woman in a neatly tailored deep-navy interview suit skirt and white blouse stepped inside.
nodes.al2_053: Though she had braced herself in the hall, the moment she looked up and saw five surgeons—including the hospital director—seated in a neat row behind the long table, meeting Emiko Mido's cool, appraising gaze and Artoria's upright, solemn posture, her shoulders visibly stiffened for an instant.
nodes.al2_054: Yet she didn't fumble her words. Stopping squarely beside the applicant's chair, she offered a proper bow; though a trace of tension ran through her voice, every syllable came out clear and distinct:
nodes.al2_055: “G-Good afternoon, members of the interview panel. My name is Maki Aizawa, applying today for the position of General Surgeon, having completed my initial clinical surgical training and foundational specialty rotations. Thank you very much for granting me this interview opportunity today!”
nodes.al2_056: Asuka inclined her head with a warm smile and opened the folder before her—the education line clearly bore the name of the very same women's medical university Asuka and Kaori Miyama had attended, graduated two classes behind them. Yet Asuka betrayed no hint of private familiarity, and Maki Aizawa made not a single mention of alumnae ties, taking her seat neatly on the front third of the chair at Asuka's gesture.
nodes.al2_057: “No need to be too nervous, Dr. Aizawa—today we mainly want to hear your honest thoughts on clinical practice. Looking over your CV, the general hospital where you previously worked was quite a large institution. Why did you choose to apply to Hoshimi Hospital at this stage?”
nodes.al2_058: Resting both hands neatly on her knees, Maki Aizawa answered earnestly:
nodes.al2_059: “Yes. My previous hospital did have a large case volume, but the department roster was packed full. For a young female doctor at my level of seniority, daily work was largely fixed to ward management, charting, and holding second-assistant retractors—all year round, it was very difficult to be scheduled for complete open surgical procedures under structured guidance.”
nodes.al2_060: She paused briefly, lifting her eyes toward Asuka at the center of the table, genuine professional hunger shining through her gaze:
nodes.al2_061: “I want to become a surgeon who can truly stand at the operating table to solve problems and take independent responsibility for patients, rather than staying on the periphery writing paperwork forever. I heard that Hoshimi Hospital places strong emphasis on hands-on open surgery and gives young doctors real table time and room to grow, so I hoped to come here and undergo strict training from the ground up.”
nodes.al2_062: Seated on the left, Emiko Mido lowered her eyes to turn past the operative log sheet appended to the résumé and delivered the first question directly, her tone cool and razor-sharp.
nodes.al2_063: “I've met plenty of doctors who want table time. Going by your rotation log, you've scrubbed in on plenty of routine appendectomies, inguinal hernias, and superficial masses, while every medium-to-major abdominal case was as second assistant. Let me give you a concrete scenario—suppose you're standing as first assistant or even lead surgeon, dissecting dense inflammatory adhesions in the right lower quadrant, when dark venous blood suddenly wells up from the retroperitoneal side and edematous tissue obscures the planes. What is your immediate first move?”
nodes.al2_064: Confronted suddenly by the hospital's strictest Surgical Lead, Maki's breath hitched slightly—yet the moment she stepped onto concrete medical judgment, her answer flowed far more steadily and solidly than her self-introduction:
nodes.al2_065: “Never clamp blindly with a hemostat, and never buzz indiscriminately with electrocautery! When tissue is edematous and adherent toward the retroperitoneum, the right ureter and iliac vessel branches lie immediately deep to it—clamping blindly without seeing the bleeding point invites irreversible collateral injury.”
nodes.al2_066: “And while blood keeps welling up, you just stand there watching?”
nodes.al2_067: “First, pack the bleeding site directly with warm saline laparotomy pads for tamponade while asking the circulating nurse to ready suction, blood products, and blood-pressure support; after several minutes of pressure bring the brisk venous oozing under control, work with my assistant to gently suction along the margin and re-identify the anatomical plane. And if lifting the pad reveals a vascular rent beyond what I can safely suture-ligate at my current level—I maintain compression and immediately call for a senior attending surgeon to take over, never forcing it out of pride.”
nodes.al2_068: Emiko Mido studied her for two seconds, set the log sheet down, and offered a cool, noncommittal remark:
nodes.al2_069: “You've memorized the anatomical contraindications without error. The question is whether your hands stay half as steady as your answer once an actual field fills with blood.”
nodes.al2_070: Maki Aizawa (blinking slightly, then bowing her head honestly):
nodes.al2_071: “Yes... My actual lead-surgeon experience is indeed still far from enough.”
nodes.al2_072: Next, seated on the opposite side, Artoria Pendragon picked up the questioning with calm gravity.
nodes.al2_073: “Dr. Aizawa, just now you mentioned 'immediately reporting to a senior surgeon.' In a real surgical team, a focused lead surgeon often projects an intimidating presence, and junior assistants who spot something amiss sometimes hesitate out of fear of breaking the surgeon's rhythm or being mistaken. On the table, if you notice excessive traction tension or an ambiguity in the instrument and sponge count while the lead surgeon is mid-crux, what do you do?”
nodes.al2_074: “If it's merely my own hands struggling to keep pace, I adjust and catch up on my own first; but the moment tissue tearing, questionable anatomical landmarks, or an unverified sponge or instrument count is at stake—even if my senior surgeon is irritated in the heat of the moment, I will speak up out loud.”
nodes.al2_075: A faint glint stirred in Artoria's emerald eyes:
nodes.al2_076: “Even if afterward it turns out you were overcautious—and you get reprimanded on the spot?”
nodes.al2_077: “Being reprimanded only embarrasses me for a few minutes, whereas failing to report a hazard once leaves the patient on the table to pay the price. In the operating room, I would much rather be criticized by a senior for excessive caution than swallow a doubt.”
nodes.al2_078: Artoria gave a quiet nod, a measure of approval warming her expression.
nodes.al2_079: Then Narumi Jinguji, who had been listening quietly all along, tapped the tail of her pen lightly against a timeline entry midway down the CV and spoke with a gentle smile that went straight to the heart.
nodes.al2_080: “Your reverence for patient safety leaves quite an impression, Dr. Aizawa. Still, I couldn't help noticing an intriguing gap on your record—last autumn you helped rescue an emergency case of delayed postoperative intra-abdominal hemorrhage, and the patient pulled through; yet for three whole months afterward, even though your seniority already qualified you to apply for supervised junior-primary cases, you signed up exclusively as second assistant.”
nodes.al2_081: Narumi leaned slightly forward, her gaze calm yet penetrating:
nodes.al2_082: “I'm just a little curious—under real clinical pressure, could that 'better overly cautious' principle of yours quietly turn into avoidance: staying safely in a secondary spot where you never make the call, so you never have to fear harming a patient yourself?”
nodes.al2_083: Silence fell across the conference room in an instant.
nodes.al2_084: Struck squarely where it hurt, Maki Aizawa paled slightly, both hands on her knees clenching tight around her dark skirt.
nodes.al2_085: Ryuji Sakaguchi watched her reaction quietly. The shy, reserved young doctor bit her lip—yet neither dodged the question nor dressed it up in pretty words. Instead, she drew a deep breath and lifted her head to look Narumi and all five panelists straight in the eye.
nodes.al2_086: “...You're right. Even though we saved that postoperative hemorrhage case in time, my attending said during morbidity review that had the ward caught it ten minutes later, the patient might not have made it off the table. For the first two months afterward, it truly frightened me—every time I picked up a scalpel I couldn't stop thinking, 'What if a patient dies on the table because my hands aren't fast enough?' I couldn't even bring myself to fill out a primary-surgeon request form.”
nodes.al2_087: Her voice trembled slightly, yet every word came out remarkably clear and steady:
nodes.al2_088: “But during my third month back at second assistant, I forced myself to study from scratch every vascular variation my attendings handled and every step of how they anticipated bleeding. Dr. Jinguji, if all I wanted was a safe corner free of responsibility to hide in for the rest of my career, I could have stayed at my old hospital writing routine inpatient charts every day—I wouldn't have resigned to put myself through Hoshimi Hospital's higher surgical intensity.”
nodes.al2_089: She squared her taut spine, her gaze almost disarmingly earnest:
nodes.al2_090: “Even now I still get nervous before scrubbing in, and my technique is nowhere near as seasoned as yours; but I know very well that a doctor cannot stop moving forward out of fear of failure. So long as this hospital grants me the chance to learn beside the table, I won't shy away from a single step of preparation, debriefing, or risk reporting that falls to me!”
nodes.al2_091: Narumi Jinguji raised a brow, the probing edge in her eyes melting quietly into a satisfied smile:
nodes.al2_092: “That was a very honest answer. I have no further questions.”
nodes.al2_093: Asuka Shiromiya turned her head toward Ryuji Sakaguchi beside her:
nodes.al2_094: “Dr. Sakaguchi, you scrub in alongside assistants all the time—do you have anything you'd like to ask Dr. Aizawa?”
nodes.al2_095: Closing the CV page in his hand, Sakaguchi asked in the steady, pragmatic tone of a fellow clinician:
nodes.al2_096: “You mentioned studying your seniors' hemostasis steps all over again while working as second assistant. After scrubbing out of an operation that didn't go smoothly, how do you usually review the case?”
nodes.al2_097: At a concrete question about everyday clinical habits, Maki's tense shoulders eased a fraction as she answered earnestly:
nodes.al2_098: “Within half an hour while my memory is sharpest, I sketch the day's operative planes and the exact step where things snagged in my pocket notebook—marking why exposure fell short and how many degrees shifting the retractor angle could clear the obstruction next time—and then cross-check it against the drain output on morning rounds the next day.”
nodes.al2_099: “Logging retractor angles right alongside next-day drain character—that's a grounded habit. That's all from me, Director.”
nodes.al2_100: Asuka gave a gentle nod, turned her gaze back to Maki Aizawa, and set aside her earlier welcoming smile to pose one final question in earnest as Hospital Director:
nodes.al2_101: “Dr. Aizawa, before we ask you to wait outside while we deliberate, there is one point I want to make clear up front. Hoshimi Hospital is indeed willing to give young surgeons real clinical training opportunities, but we will never lower our operating-table standards to accommodate a newcomer.”
nodes.al2_102: Folding both hands atop the résumé folder, she spoke with crisp candor:
nodes.al2_103: “Suppose we hire you, and several months down the road your supervising surgeons evaluate your progress and still judge that your composure under pressure and technical readiness aren't yet sufficient to clear you as independent lead surgeon—meaning you have to remain in the assistant role for repeated honing. How would you take that?”
nodes.al2_104: Maki blinked slightly, then met Asuka's gaze without a moment's hesitation, her expression firmer still than before:
nodes.al2_105: “If my ability truly hasn't reached the threshold of patient safety yet, then staying at the assistant post to keep honing my skills is simply doing right by our patients—I wouldn't feel wronged in the slightest!”
nodes.al2_106: She paused briefly, adding in an earnest, clear-headed voice:
nodes.al2_107: “I didn't leave my previous hospital looking for someplace willing to lower the bar or grant me special favors just so I could put 'lead surgeon' next to my name sooner. What I truly hope for are seniors willing to point out my shortcomings plainly and tell me what standard I must meet to take the next step—so long as the path of growth and the evaluation criteria are real and transparent, even if I have to train at the assistant spot longer than others, I will see it through steadily.”
nodes.al2_108: Asuka listened quietly to the end, an unmistakable glint of approval crossing her eyes before her lips curved back into a warm, assured smile.
nodes.al2_109: “I understand where you stand. Thank you for your effort today, Dr. Aizawa. Could you wait on the bench outside for just a few minutes while the five of us deliberate? We'll have our answer for you right away.”
nodes.al2_110: Maki Aizawa (rising for a solemn bow):
nodes.al2_112: The conference room door clicked shut once more. Drawing back their gazes, the five panelists launched straight into deliberation around the long table.
nodes.al2_113: Emiko Mido spoke first, her assessment as crisp and objective as ever:
nodes.al2_114: “Her fundamentals are clean—facing hemorrhage she knows to pack first rather than clamp blindly, which puts her miles ahead of reckless rookies who think fast hands mean cutting everywhere. But her composure under pressure clearly isn't forged yet. If we hire her, I do not consent to letting her scrub in as independent primary on any laparotomy at this stage.”
nodes.al2_115: Artoria Pendragon gave a nod and followed:
nodes.al2_116: “I concur with Dr. Mido's judgment; turning her loose on her own right now would be premature. Still, her answer on hazard reporting wasn't rehearsed lip service. She can be trusted on team discipline and proactive warning, and placed as an assistant in a surgical unit overseen by senior primaries, she should grow steadily.”
nodes.al2_117: Propping her chin on one hand, Narumi Jinguji wore a perceptive, knowing smile:
nodes.al2_118: “When I pressed straight on her sore spot, she didn't make excuses to dress it up—she admitted plainly that she had been scared and that her technique still isn't ripe. That kind of honesty is rare. Just make sure you do the math, Madam Director: taking on a young surgeon whose confidence has to be rebuilt hand over hand will cost real mentoring energy over the first few months. You won't sign off purely because you admire her candor, will you?”
nodes.al2_119: After listening attentively to all three, Asuka Shiromiya turned toward Ryuji Sakaguchi at her side:
nodes.al2_121: Tapping his finger lightly against the evaluation form, Sakaguchi laid out a structured recommendation:
nodes.al2_122: “Her anatomical common sense and safety floor are both solid; all she lacks right now is fluency built under controlled pressure. We can spell out a clear three-month mentoring ladder—assign her steadily to scrub in with us as first and second assistant until intraoperative hemostasis teamwork becomes second nature, then gradually clear small elective procedures for her to try under supervision.”
nodes.al2_123: Emiko Mido cast him a cool sidelong glance:
nodes.al2_124: “Since you've already mapped out the mentoring ladder, just don't complain later about how much work breaking in a rookie takes.”
nodes.al2_126: “With explicit stage-by-stage assessment criteria, team safety remains completely controllable.”
nodes.al2_127: Recalling Maki's mention of hand-sketching operative field reviews, Sakaguchi spoke in a calm, affirming tone:
nodes.al2_128: “Knowing to fear consequences at the operating table isn't a flaw—what's rare is that she didn't let fear turn into dodging responsibility, and still sketches anatomical diagrams after cases to review. Give someone willing to put in that kind of honest legwork a steady hand beside the table, and she'll turn out far more reliable than someone coasting on blind confidence.”
nodes.al2_129: Narumi Jinguji curved her eyes in a light laugh:
nodes.al2_130: “Sounds like our Dr. Sakaguchi thinks quite highly of this earnest junior.”
nodes.al2_131: Emiko Mido let out a quiet huff:
nodes.al2_132: “Reliable or not, once she scrubs in she'll be held strictly to standard all the same.”
nodes.al2_133: Having heard all four surgical colleagues out, Asuka closed the folder before her without a trace of hesitation or muddled compromise, sweeping her bright gaze around the table to deliver her decision:
nodes.al2_134: “I've heard everyone's reservations and endorsements loud and clear. Then I'm making the official call—Hoshimi Hospital will extend an offer to Maki Aizawa as a General Surgeon.”
nodes.al2_135: Holding up a finger, she laid out the post-hire boundaries of responsibility with crystal clarity:
nodes.al2_136: “Our surgical department already has Dr. Mido, Deputy Chief Pendragon, Dr. Jinguji, and Dr. Sakaguchi holding the line—we have zero shortage of seasoned lead surgeons for routine or complex operations, and we were never looking to hire a miracle worker expected to save the day on arrival. Besides, she said it plainly herself: what she wants is a transparent, rigorous standard, not special treatment. Unless we give a young surgeon a real place beside the operating table, clinical confidence can never grow out of thin air.”
nodes.al2_137: “In line with what we just discussed, during her initial phase after onboarding she won't be scheduled as independent primary; she'll be assigned across your surgical teams to be trained hands-on from the assistant post. Any extra staffing buffer needed while she settles in will come out of my director's budget—never squeezed out of Nursing or anyone's normal rest hours. Only when she truly stands steady at the table will all of you jointly evaluate clearing her for independent procedures. No objections to this plan, right?”
nodes.al2_138: “Clear lines of authority and responsibility. I have no objection.”
nodes.al2_139: Emiko Mido (standing up to gather her chart folder):
nodes.al2_140: “So long as nobody confuses lowering standards with training newcomers, arrange it as you see fit.”
nodes.al2_141: Two minutes later, Maki Aizawa was invited back into the conference room.
nodes.al2_142: “Thank you for waiting, Dr. Aizawa. Following deliberation among all five panelists, on behalf of Hoshimi Hospital I am pleased to extend a formal offer appointing you as a General Surgeon at our hospital. Upon arrival you will first join our senior surgeons' teams as an assistant, advancing step by step under transparent, rigorous evaluation standards—will you accept this offer?”
nodes.al2_143: Maki Aizawa froze for a heartbeat; then the rims of her eyes warmed almost imperceptibly. Pressing both hands neatly to her sides, she bowed deeply from the waist, her voice ringing out far clearer and fuller than when she first walked in:
nodes.al2_144: “I accept! Thank you so much, Director Shiromiya, and thank you to all of my senior colleagues for giving me this opportunity!”
nodes.al2_146: “Welcome to Hoshimi. Seeing on your application that you still have handover wrap-up at your current hospital, let's set your official start date for roughly one month from now. This afternoon you only need to stop by the first-floor HR window to complete your offer registration and preliminary paperwork—we'll see you again next month on your official onboarding day.”
nodes.al2_147: “Yes! In one month's time I will report to the hospital right on schedule, and I will do everything I can to live up to everyone's expectations!”
nodes.al2_148: At 3:05 p.m., after seeing off a profusely grateful Maki Aizawa—headed downstairs to HR to complete her offer registration and preliminary paperwork ahead of her formal onboarding in roughly a month—Mido, Artoria, and Narumi also took their leave one after another for afternoon clinic and ward rounds.
nodes.al2_149: Barely had the door clicked shut when Asuka Shiromiya, who moments ago had presided at the head of the table signing off on hospital personnel, let out a long breath, dropped her shoulders, and the very next second padded briskly behind the corner screen to wheel that mobile garment rack right back out.
nodes.al2_150: Gathering up the blank evaluation sheets on the table, Ryuji Sakaguchi couldn't help smiling at the sight:
nodes.al2_151: “The interview barely wrapped up, and Director Shiromiya has already switched seamlessly back into garment-review committee mode?”
nodes.al2_152: “Didn't I tell you that when outsiders aren't around, 'Asuka' or 'Shiromiya-kun' is plenty! Besides, time was so tight earlier that nobody got around to trying Sample #4 on the end—the sky-blue cut patterned specifically for petite young female staff!”
nodes.al2_153: Even as she spoke, Asuka had already slipped briskly out of her director's white coat, folded it over a chair back, lifted the clear, soft sky-mist-blue long-sleeved sample gown from the end of the rack, and slid both arms into it over her blouse.
nodes.al2_154: Because sterile surgical gowns use a full-overlap back-tie closure, she angled herself before the mirror reaching twice for the waist ties behind her, then simply turned her back toward Sakaguchi and glanced over her shoulder with natural ease:
nodes.al2_155: “Sakaguchi-kun, lend me a hand! They changed this sample to an offset double-tie closure, and reaching behind myself I can't tell whether the back panel is pulled smooth—could you tie the outer ribbon for me and check how the shoulders and back fit?”
nodes.al2_157: Stepping up a pace behind her, Sakaguchi took the two clean, flat cotton ties and knotted a neat, standard slip bow at the right side of her back waist. Cut specifically to petite adult female proportions, once the tie drew snug, the long-sleeved surgical gown—so prone to looking bulky and cavernous—settled naturally into a crisp, refreshing line along her shoulders, back, and waist.
nodes.al2_158: Asuka turned back to face the full-length mirror, angling left and right before lifting both arms to test retractor-holding and knot-tying postures. Taking in the clean, gentle sky-mist blue and its poised drape in the glass, her eyes curved into crescents of genuine delight:
nodes.al2_159: “Mm—the hand-feel of this double-ply combed cotton blend is so comfortable! Way softer around the collar than Sample #3 earlier, and with just a subtle curve shaped into the side waist, from the front it finally doesn't look like wearing a giant bedsheet!”
nodes.al2_160: Sakaguchi stepped half a pace back to take a proper look. Compared with the hospital's current batch of dark-green gowns faded dull from countless washings, this clear, gentle sky-mist blue really did take the heavy gloom out of surgical attire, while the slightly tailored shoulder line and side-waist proportions looked neat and poised—preserving proper surgical formality while being far easier on the eyes.
nodes.al2_161: “It really is nice. That mist-blue shade looks much fresher and softer than the old issue, and the tailoring through the shoulders and waist is clean and crisp—it suits your energy well.”
nodes.al2_162: Asuka's eyes lit up at once, turning toward Sakaguchi with the unmistakable delight of someone who had found a kindred eye:
nodes.al2_163: “Right?! I always felt sterile gowns never needed to be drab and boxy forever!”
nodes.al2_164: Standing slightly behind and to her side, Sakaguchi checked the run of the shoulder seam once more as she lifted her elbows and gave a matter-of-fact nod:
nodes.al2_165: “And it isn't only the front that looks good—the back overlap has plenty of width so turning won't gap open, and when you raised your hands to mime needle driving just now, there was ample ease across the shoulder blades instead of pulling taut like Sample #1.”
nodes.al2_166: Asuka spun around and lifted her chin proudly toward him:
nodes.al2_167: “Hehe, spoken like an insider! Moving the back dart into the side seam preserves full working room while making the silhouette ten times cleaner!”
nodes.al2_168: Watching her earnestly compare cuff bindings before the mirror, Sakaguchi couldn't resist a gentle tease:
nodes.al2_169: “Sitting behind that long table signing off on a new hire a moment ago, you carried every bit of a hospital director's authority—how come the second you slip on a new surgical gown, you're grinning happier than a kid with a piece of candy?”
nodes.al2_170: A faint warmth touched Asuka's cheeks, yet without a trace of self-consciousness she planted both hands on the sample gown's waist and shot right back:
nodes.al2_171: “Chairing a serious meeting and loving a well-made surgical gown don't conflict one bit! Getting to personally refine the gear we wear every single day until it's both professional and a joy to put on—isn't being happy the most natural thing in the world?”
nodes.al2_172: Turning back to the mirror, Asuka raised both arms level once more—only for her smiling gaze to land beneath the armhole and freeze mid-motion.
nodes.al2_173: Looking down at the cuff, she blinked thoughtfully:
nodes.al2_176: “No, nothing's chafing. It just hit me—every motion Dr. Mido, Dr. Pendragon, and I tested just now was a surgeon's posture standing right against the table looking down into the field, where our elbows stay mostly tucked near our sides.”
nodes.al2_177: Turning back to pick up the internal desk handset, her expression grew extraordinarily thorough and earnest:
nodes.al2_178: “Yet the people who wear the exact same sterile gowns right alongside us every single day are our OR scrub nurses! At the table, scrub nurses are constantly reaching clear across the instrument table for kidney basins in the back row, lifting heavy trays, counting sponges, and pivoting fast to slap a hemostat squarely into the lead surgeon's palm—their forward reach and arm sweep are way wider than a surgeon's. Signing off just because a few doctors find the fit nice wouldn't be rigorous at all!”
nodes.al2_179: As luck would have it, Hiroko Sugimura had just finished checking the afternoon backup instrument packs on the fourth floor; answering Asuka's internal call, she knocked lightly and stepped in less than five minutes later.
nodes.al2_180: “Director, Dr. Sakaguchi—did you call me down to test-fit next quarter's sterile gown samples?”
nodes.al2_181: “Mm-hmm! Sorry for pulling you over, Nurse Sugimura. This medium Sample #4 felt great to us doctors in shoulder line and lightness—slip it on and put it through the exact paces of your busiest stretch at the Mayo stand!”
nodes.al2_182: Agreeing with a warm smile, Hiroko Sugimura took the medium sky-mist-blue Sample #4 and slid it deftly over her nurse's uniform while Asuka personally fastened the ties behind her back.
nodes.al2_183: Rather than stepping in front of the mirror, Hiroko walked straight to the long conference table, treating its broad surface like a sterile back table as she demonstrated a fluid sequence of standard scrub-nurse maneuvers in focused earnest—first extending both arms fifty centimeters straight forward as if retrieving a deep-retractor tray from the back row, then flicking her wrist and pivoting her torso a crisp forty-five degrees in the brisk motion of slapping a hemostat cleanly into a surgeon's palm, before raising both hands high to mime holding sponges up to the light for a pre-closure count.
nodes.al2_184: After three brisk sets of reach-and-pass drills, Hiroko paused, glanced down at her forearm and underarm, and pointed out the issue with gentle precision:
nodes.al2_185: “The color and breathability are miles nicer than our current issue, and my shoulders don't feel weighed down lifting heavy trays. However, Director, Dr. Sakaguchi—take a look right under the armhole and along the underside of the forearm here—”
nodes.al2_186: Hiroko extended her right arm wide and straight forward once more so both of them could see the pull of the fabric:
nodes.al2_187: “To shape that sleek narrow sleeve, the underarm panel sits fairly snug while a slightly flared decorative fold was left along the underside of the forearm. When scrub nurses repeatedly reach far across the table for distant instruments and snap back to pass them, the tight underarm yanks the entire cuff upward toward the elbow; worse still, that extra curved fold hanging beneath the forearm could easily brush the tips of upright hemostats lined along the front row as we reach across.”
nodes.al2_188: Leaning in beside her to examine the under-sleeve fold swaying slightly as Hiroko extended her arm, Asuka let out a soft little 'Ah.'
nodes.al2_189: That flowing under-sleeve dart curve happened to be the single most distinctive detail on Sample #4—the exact touch she had admired most in the mirror moments ago.
nodes.al2_190: Asuka stared at that pretty cuff in conflicted silence for a full two seconds, murmuring under her breath:
nodes.al2_191: “Ugh... When your arm hangs still, that curve makes the forearm look so sleek and slender, though...”
nodes.al2_192: By the third second, however, she had already snatched up the red pen from the table and drawn a bold X straight across the under-sleeve fold on Sample #4's pattern sheet, her revision notes flying across the margin:
nodes.al2_193: “Brushing a sterile instrument table is an absolute taboo! Then we trim that extra decorative fold beneath the forearm completely flat and clean, and add a hidden diamond gusset under the armhole—that way, when you and the other scrub nurses reach for trays in the back row, the cuff won't get yanked upward anymore, right?”
nodes.al2_194: Genuine admiration and amusement glinted in Hiroko Sugimura's eyes as she untied the sample gown, teasing gently:
nodes.al2_195: “Add an underarm gusset and flatten the lower sleeve seam, and passing instruments will feel effortless. Honestly, seeing how fond you looked of that sleeve earlier, Director, I half expected you to plead for keeping a little of it.”
nodes.al2_196: “In the operating room, safe, effortless handling for all of you obviously comes first! Good thing I called you down to test it today—if we'd mass-ordered these and only discovered they swept the Mayo stand once they hit the OR, I'd never live it down as director.”
nodes.al2_197: “Hehe, then I'll look forward to wearing the finalized gowns once your revisions are ready. I still have a batch of sterile packs to sign for up on the fourth floor, so I'll head back to work now—excuse me, Director, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
nodes.al2_198: After watching Hiroko Sugimura close the door behind her with a smile, warm late-afternoon sunlight slanted through the windows across the quieted room.
nodes.al2_199: Asuka untied the Sample #4 gown she was wearing as well, folding it gently and meticulously along its creases into a neat square to place back inside the sample box before slipping once more into her slightly oversized director's white coat.
nodes.al2_200: Leaning against the edge of the table as she clipped five densely annotated revision cards into the procurement binder, Sakaguchi couldn't help chuckling:
nodes.al2_201: “From two o'clock until now—first patiently mapping out a mentoring plan for a nervous rookie surgeon, then going toe-to-toe with a pattern sheet over a two-centimeter underarm gusset—I can safely say you put every bit as much rigor into choosing surgical gowns as you do into choosing surgeons.”
nodes.al2_202: Gathering the thick swatch book and procurement binder against her chest, Asuka looked up to meet Sakaguchi's gaze, stuck out the tip of her tongue sheepishly for a split second, and then curved her eyes into a candid, sunlit smile:
nodes.al2_203: “Because whether it's a newly hired doctor or the surgical gown we wear every day, you have to put them through real work in the operating room and listen to the people beside you before you know if they truly fit.”
nodes.al2_204: Walking over to the window to glance out at the bright hospital courtyard, she spoke in a lighter, softer voice than during the meeting, filled with undisguised affection:
nodes.al2_205: “Besides, in front of you there's nothing to hide, Sakaguchi-kun—I really, truly love everything about the operating room. Scrubs, full-coverage surgical caps, tie-on masks, and that sense of ceremony when everyone stands around the table neatly gowned and gloved—just looking at it lifts my spirits. Now that Hoshimi Hospital has been entrusted to my hands, of course I want it to uphold the most dependable medical standards while looking crisp and bright enough to make everyone happy just walking in each day!”
nodes.al2_206: At that, Asuka's eyes suddenly sparkled as she spun back from the window hugging her binder, looking at Sakaguchi as though an inspired new idea had just struck:
nodes.al2_207: “Oh, right! Once this new batch of surgical gowns incorporating both the doctors' and nurses' feedback arrives... next time the hospital holds a seasonal celebration or Hospital Festival, what if we let our doctors and nurses each pick their favorite surgical outfit cut and styling for a little 'Hoshimi Surgical Attire Showcase'? Wouldn't that be super lively?!”
nodes.al2_208: An instant mental image of Emiko Mido and Artoria marching down a stage runway in sterile surgical gowns flashed across Sakaguchi's mind, making the corner of his mouth twitch subtly.
nodes.al2_209: “...If you ever dare submit that proposal at surgical morning conference, I suggest figuring out ahead of time how to talk Dr. Mido out of ripping the notice in half on the spot.”
nodes.al2_210: “Hehe, where there's a will, there's a way! And if we really pull it off when the time comes, no standing on the sidelines watching—you'll have to sit on the judging panel and cast a serious vote for me, Sakaguchi-kun!”
nodes.al2_211: Giving the procurement binder in her arms a cheerful little wave, she stepped lightly to the conference room door and turned back with a bright wave of her hand.
nodes.al2_212: “Working back-to-back with me through both the interview and the fittings today was a huge help, Sakaguchi-kun! I'm off to send these revision notes to the vendor—see you in the OR tomorrow!”
nodes.al2_214: The young director's bright, brisk footsteps gradually faded down the corridor. Looking back at the tidied conference table, Ryuji Sakaguchi gave a quiet smile—beneath the white coat of the young director who carried the weight of an entire hospital every day, that earnest, vivid personal passion of hers felt clearer than ever before.
